item.title: Migrating the Main Zig Repository from GitHub to Codeberg
item.description:
📝 GitHub SponsorsThe only concern we have in leaving GitHub behind has to do with GitHub Sponsors. Let us please consider the GitHub issues that remain open as metaphorically “copy-on-write”. Please leave all your existing GitHub issues and pull requests alone.
